evidence: Homepage lists 8 job openings with full details in cards.
Industry filter (Technology) reduced 8→2 jobs correctly; Location filter (New York, NY) reduced to 1 correct job; Job Type filter (Contract) reduced to 1 correct job.
Searching "React" correctly filtered to the Senior Frontend Developer job listing which has React as a skill.
All filter/search changes updated the "Showing N jobs" count and list immediately without needing a reload or submit action.
Each job card displays title, company, location, salary range, posted date, and skill tags.
Job details page for job-1 shows full description, responsibilities, requirements list, and Required Skills tags (React, TypeScript, CSS, Node.js).
Application form with Full Name, Email, Phone, Cover Letter/Message fields submitted successfully, showing "Application submitted!" toast.
Submission returned immediate success confirmation toast: "Your application for Senior Frontend Developer at TechCorp Solutions has been sent." with no errors.

Submitting the empty form was blocked by required-field validation (checkValidity() false for name/email/message). Submitting with malformed email "not-an-email" was blocked by email-type validation (checkValidity() false).

actual: Submitted a second application to the same job (job-1) using the identical email (test.applicant@example.com) and name. The system accepted it and displayed the same "Application submitted!" success toast with no duplicate warning or rejection.

evidence: Filled Job Title, Min/Max Salary, Description and submitted; toast "Job posted successfully! Your job listing is now live and visible to job seekers." and new "QA Test Job" appeared in employer dashboard listings.

issue: Incomplete job posting was published without validation error
actual: Submitted the "Post a Job" form leaving Industry, Employment Type, and Location (all marked required with *) unselected, only filling Title, Salary range, and Description. The form was accepted with a success toast "Job posted successfully!" and the job appeared live in the dashboard/listings with no industry/type/location tag and no error notification, instead of being blocked with a clear notification.

evidence: Employer Dashboard "Your Job Listings" section lists all 6 posted jobs (including the newly created QA Test Job) with title, location, salary, and post date.

Clicking the application-count button on a job listing expands an "Applications (4)" panel listing all submitted applications for that job (Test Applicant x2, Alex Johnson, Maria Garcia) with contact info and messages.
Applications panel clearly distinguishes each applicant with separate cards showing name (Test Applicant, Alex Johnson, Maria Garcia), email, phone (when provided), submission date, and message text.

issue: No edit functionality for published jobs
actual: Delete works (trash icon on dashboard opens confirmation dialog "Delete this job?" and removes the job, decrementing Active Jobs count from 6 to 5). However, no edit/update capability exists anywhere: the job listing rows in the employer dashboard only expose an applications-count button and a delete button, clicking the job title does nothing, and the public job detail page (/jobs/job-2) has no edit option either.

issue: No authentication/role restriction prevents job seekers from posting jobs
actual: The app has no login or role-based access control. The "Post a Job" link and "Employer" dashboard link are visible in the global navigation on every page (including the public job-browsing homepage) with no sign-in gate. Throughout testing, a job was successfully created, viewed in the dashboard, and deleted without ever authenticating as an employer — meaning any job seeker/visitor can freely post job openings.
